units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 28a:6">Kidd. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ט׳ מעליית׳ היא</he> is not this a good plea?—Pl. <cite ref="I00621"><he>טַעֲנָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 18a:8">Keth. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כולהי ט׳ טענת וכ׳</he> all pleas consist of the claim of other people and one’s own admission (replique).
